entries.german:
Gregor von Starhemberg trifft als Vogt des St. Magdalena-Gotteshauses zu Oepping eine Absprache mit Caspar Fierneyser, Pfarrer zu Rohrbach, wegen der Gefäll und Opfer in der Kirche zu Oepping.

"Vermergkht die abred zwischen dem wolgebornen herren, herrn Gregorien von Starhemberg(1) etc. als vogt des wirdigen gotzhaus sanndt Madalena zu Epping(2) ains, vnnd des geistlichen herren Casparn Vierniesser(3), pfarrer zu Rarbach annders tails, von wegen der gefallung vnnd opfer bey gedachter kirchen zu Epping, die weil kirchfart daselbshin jn jrem fürganng ist, beschehen, jn mass artickhls weiss hernach folgt: Erstlich sol gedachtem pfarrer von Rarbach, wann er oder sein gesellen zu Epping jn sanndt Madalena gotzhaus mess singen oder lesen, das opfer jn gellt, dieweil die ob alltar steen, on mittel volgen. - Zum anndern sol abermals jn der taffl der gellt samlung, dartzu auch jm stockh, gedachtem pfarrer der drytail vnd nit mer gedeychen. - Zum dryten was bey gedachtem gotzhaus gefellt, dieweil vnnd die gnad oder kirchfart jn jrem fürganng ist, es sein kass, air vnnd hennen, darjnn sol jm pfarrer abermals der drytail vnnd nit mer vnnd die anndern zwen tail dem gotzhaus nachfolgen. - Zum vierden was vber solhs nichtz ausgenomen zu gemellten gotzhaus geopfert oder geben wirdet, das sol on als mittel ganntz vnnd gar beym gotzhaus beleyben. - Vmb solhen ausgezaigten gebürenden vnnd abgeredten drytail sollen der pfarrer oder sein gesellen all sambstag nacht, auch dartzu an anndern veirnächten, damit die kirchfart dester merer ansehens trage, vesper ze singen schuldig sein. Darfür sol ains pfarrer gesellen ain jar vom gotzhaus zway pfundt, vnnd von aim pfarrer ain pfundt pfenning geben vnnd geraicht werden. - Vnnd wann die kirchfart abgeet vnnd nit mer jn jrem furganng vnnd haimsuchung sein würde, ist dise abred auch tod vnnd ain nullitæt vnnd sol verrer darnach gehallten werden, wye es dann vorher von allter gebraucht vnnd gehanndlt worden ist on geuerd. Diser abred zetl sind zwo jn gleicher lawt aufgericht, geschriben vnnd ausainannder geschnitten vnnd yeder tail aine angenomen. Beschehen zu Pirhenstain, sontags vor Erasmi, anno Domini etc. XVo vnnd jm funfften."
entries.english:
Gregor von Starhemberg, as Vogt of the St. Magdalena church at Oepping, makes an agreement with Caspar Fierneyser, parish priest of Rohrbach, concerning the revenues and offerings at the church at Oepping.

“Record of the agreement between the well-born Lord Gregor von Starhemberg, etc., as Vogt of the venerable church of St. Magdalena at Oepping, on one side, and the reverend Caspar Vierniesser, parish priest of Rohrbach, on the other, concerning the revenues and offerings at the said church at Oepping, while the pilgrimage there continues, agreed as follows in articles:

First, whenever the said priest of Rohrbach or one of his assistants sings or reads Mass at the church of St. Magdalena at Oepping, the offering in money shall be given to him immediately, while they are standing at the altar.

Second, of the money collected in the offertory plate and also in the offering box, the said priest shall receive one third and no more.

Third, of whatever is given to the said church while the indulgence or pilgrimage there continues—whether cheese, eggs, or hens—the priest shall likewise receive one third and no more, and the other two thirds shall go to the church.

Fourth, whatever else is offered or given to the said church, without exception, shall remain entirely with the church.

In return for the aforesaid due and agreed one-third share, the priest or his assistants shall be obliged to sing vespers every Saturday night and also on the other four nights, so that the pilgrimage may be held in greater esteem. For this, an assistant priest shall be paid two pounds a year by the church, and the parish priest shall be paid one pound in pennies.

When the pilgrimage ends and is no longer in progress, this agreement shall also end and be null and void; thereafter, the old custom and practice shall again be followed, without deceit. Two copies of this agreement, identical in wording, have been drawn up, written, and cut apart, and each party has taken one. Done at Pirhenstain, on the Sunday before St. Erasmus’ Day, in the year of our Lord 1505.”
